params:
  state: "NY"

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(csgjcr)
library(highcharter)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(reactable)

source("R/page-data.R")
source("R/utils.R")

# htmlwidgets seeds its element IDs from this, so rerenders give identical HTML
set.seed(2019)

# params exists when Quarto renders; interactive runs use the YAML default
if (!exists("params")) {
  params <- list(state = "NY")
}

state <- state_name_from_abbr(params$state)
state_name_text <- state_place_text(params$state)
show_solved <- shows_solve_rates(state)
no_solve_data_text <- no_solve_data_sentence(state_name_text)

srs_state_new <- read_srs_state()
srs_state <- violent_by_offense(srs_state_new, backlog_first_year, state)
solve_coverage <- read_solve_coverage()

page_title <- paste0(state, ": backlog of unsolved violent crime")
```

---
pagetitle: "`r page_title`"
---

```{r}
#| output: asis

### when show-solved is false or missing, the page shows no_solve_data_text
show_solved_meta(show_solved)
```
